title: Compact Cell Imaging Device (CoCID) Provides Insights into the Cellular Origins of Viral Infections
content: The European Union Horizon 2020 project called CoCID, the ‘Compact Cell Imaging Device,’ which started in January 2021 and comes to a close in May 2025, brought together a consortium of seven institutions with combined deep expertise in the fields of cell imaging and virology. The project has focused on the development of a compact soft x-ray microscope for three-dimensional label-free imaging of whole cells in the laboratory [1] and then demonstrating the capabilities of this device, combined with complementary light and electron microscopy approaches, through a series of virology use cases to generate new scientific knowledge about the viral life cycle and host cell response to viral infection.
